Android did not start this sensor. It may be a one-shot sensor, or it may need a permission that DeviceSpec does not request.
Waiting for a reading. Some sensors only report when their value changes.

DeviceSpec %1$s shows the facts about this device that matter when debugging, and builds a plain-text report to paste into a bug.

It declares no permissions, has no Internet access, no ads and no analytics. Nothing is stored and nothing leaves the device unless you share a report yourself.

The fingerprint and model identify the device type and are included in the report. DeviceSpec does not read the IMEI, serial number, Android ID, MAC address, accounts, phone numbers or advertising ID.

Network details are left out on purpose, so no network permission is needed.

OEM builds differ, so a value that a device refuses to give is shown as Unavailable.
